simple.meaning: חֲדִי (chădîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a breast.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: חֲדִי (chădîy) / H2306 is traced through Daniel 2:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2306. chadi [ חֲדִי ], or (K § 65, 6 a )) חַד ] noun masculine breast ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew II. חזה ); — dual (Schulth ZAW xxii (1902), 164 ) suffix חֲדוֺ֫הִי Dan 2:32 .
